description: Reads one report of a webinar in a normalised shape: single values such as registrations, attendance and conversion, plus the table rows behind them. `type` picks the report: funnel (visitor to registration to attendance to offer), mail_waves (what the live bulk send and the evergreen daily send delivered) or leads (the registrant list with attendance and purchase). Leave `type` out and it lists which report types this installation knows and what backs each one. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it when the host asks for a report as a whole, or wants the numbers in one table. For one question use the sharper tool: wi_get_webinar_funnel_conversion_stats for conversion, wi_get_webinar_attendance_stats for the show-up rate, wi_list_webinar_leads_registrants for the people. `range` narrows the period. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

range.description: The period, as the site names it, e.g. 7d, 30d or all.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

type.description: Which report to read. Leave it out to list the report types of this installation.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Leave it out to list the report types.

name: wi_get_webinar_report
title: Read a report of a webinar
